# Development hand-off: Atlas

Workspace: /development/synthetic-atlas on another-development-host


## Requested outcome
Implement search for the project list within Atlas project navigation.

## Relevant decisions and context
Add a searchable project list to Atlas, retaining the current selection while searching.

## Constraints and scope
Keep changes within project navigation. Do not deploy. Follow the receiving workspace’s existing guidance and workflow; no new permissions are granted.

## Checkable acceptance criteria
Searching filters the project list without changing the current project selection. If the selected project is filtered out, its selection remains intact and its highlight returns when it reappears. Labels use Australian English, including ‘Search projects’ and ‘No matching projects’.

## References
https://example.org/atlas-design

Read this workspace's AGENTS.md and relevant maintained guidance, then use its established development workflow. This brief does not grant new permissions or authorise deployment or publication. Resolve missing authority in the receiving workspace.
